panels.rationale: The renal H&E biopsy is a real patient specimen and demonstrates necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis, explicitly attributed to microscopic polyangiitis by the caption and in-text diagnosis. A scale bar is visible.

panels.figure_caption: Renal biopsy showed global (4/23) or segmental (6/23) glomerulosclerosis, focal segmental necrotizing glomerulonephritis with endocapillary lesions, fibrocellular crescents (10/23), and accompanied by marked tubulointerstitial inflammation
in_text_mentions: eveal any aneurysms or arteriovenous malformations. Based on his positive MPO-ANCA and renal biopsy findings with pauci-immune necrotizing glomerulonephritis and tubulointerstitial inflammation (Fig. 2), a diagnosis of MPA was made, in accordance with 2012 revised International Chapel Hill Consensus Conference Nomenclature of vasculitides [8]. The patients’ spontaneous intracranial SAH was attributed to MPA. He was administered prednisone (60 mg/day) combined with intravenous pulse CTX administration for 6 months and then switched to mycophenolate mofetil (MMF 1.0 g/day) for maintenance immuno
